## Natural history notes

A tiny sheetweb spider characterized by its bright reddish-orange body, long slender legs, and contrasting dark to black abdomen or tail-end. In Florida, it is found in low vegetation, grasses, shrubs, forest edges, gardens, fields, and moist open areas where it can attach small sheet-like webs close to the ground or among plants. It feeds on very small insects and other tiny arthropods that become trapped in its web and is often overlooked because of its small size despite its vivid coloration.
